connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.getengram.app over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the debragail account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
